notes: §1985:VIII.4.5.2 prints Format 1 "READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END ...] [NOT AT END ...] [END-READ]" and Format 2 "READ file-name-1 RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [INVALID KEY ...] [NOT INVALID KEY ...]", in the printed sequence (§1985:IV.2.1). readStatement parses the superset, Associates keeps the two phrase pairs apart, KeyedIoBinder#BindRead holds each format to its access mode (CheckReadRandomAccessPhrases, the INVALID KEY screen, CheckReadDynamicNextWritten for SR3, CheckReadKeyOrganization for KEY IS), and at 85 VisitConditionalPhrases refuses a NOT phrase first while VisitReadDirection, VisitRecordLockPhrase, VisitReadIgnoringLock, VisitReadAdvancingOnLock and VisitRetryPhrase refuse the 2002 additions. Probes at --std 85: b) NOT AT END first and NOT INVALID KEY first COBOL0900, INTO before RECORD and INTO twice COBOL2269, AT END with INVALID KEY COBOL2269, NEXT with INVALID KEY on a random file COBOL2269, INVALID KEY on sequential access COBOL1720 (SR2), AT END on random access COBOL1720 (SR4), KEY IS on a relative file COBOL0864; c) PREVIOUS, WITH LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, ADVANCING ON LOCK and RETRY each COBOL0900, dynamic AT END without NEXT COBOL7144 (SR3); d) INTO a ref-modified WS(3:4) and into WE(RK) whose subscript the sequential READ itself sets to 3 (GR8b: evaluated after the read, WE(3)=CCC); a) a RECORD VARYING file read INTO a longer item is a group move padded with spaces; e) sequential, random and dynamic access run, at end gives 10, key 0, 2 (absent) and 9999 give INVALID KEY with 23, a READ of a closed file gives 47 with neither phrase run. The witness runs Format 1 with and without NEXT and RECORD and Format 2 with and without INTO. The prior PARTIAL (phrase order) is fixed by kb/Work PB5158 (landed). History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5102 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-11-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 relative READ: Format 1 READ f [NEXT] RECORD [INTO] [AT END][NOT AT END], Format 2 READ f RECORD [INTO] [INVALID KEY][NOT INVALID KEY], each pair in fixed order. §2023:14.9.30.2 adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, retry-phrase, WITH [NO] LOCK and puts the AT END/INVALID KEY pairs in choice indicators (either order); §2023:14.9.30.3 SR9 implies NEXT in dynamic mode when AT END is written, where 1985 SR3 required NEXT. The KEY phrase is not new for relative files (§2023:14.9.30.3 SR10 'only if ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED'). More forms accepted; 1985 forms keep their meaning. CHANGED (looser).
